content: Ligand 1 is the phenyl molecule: jnk3 0.70, the highest activity in four runs, wasted by QED 0.623. Atom 11 is the azine carbon carrying that phenyl at atom 12 over a non-ring biaryl bond, and atom 22 is the cyclopentane CH on the carbonyl at atom 1. Both problems are lipophilicity, so I will fix both in this episode. Step one replaces the benzene with a 1-methylpyrazol-4-yl: still a flat aromatic in the same position, but a five-membered ring with two nitrogens, worth over two log units and about 18 of polar surface. The fragment has exactly six atoms like the benzene it replaces, so the numbering downstream is unchanged and I can plan the second cut now.
